changeSet.author: nathp
changeSet.comment: Rename legacy traceAuthorType field to authorType in trace snapshots stored in feedback.associations JSON.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE feedback SET associations = jsonb_set( associations::jsonb, '{traces}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(trace_element, 'traceAuthorType') THEN (trace_element - 'traceAuthorType') || jsonb_build_object('authorType', trace_element -> 'traceAuthorType') ELSE trace_element END ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element ) ) WHERE associations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(associations::jsonb, 'traces') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element WHERE jsonb_exists(trace_element, 'traceAuthorType') );

rollback.comment: No rollback needed: authorType is the current field name read by the application.
